summary_en: 128,200 shares (0.45% of shares outstanding) to be acquired costless on 2026-08-28 and cancelled on 2026-09-30, pursuant to termination of equity trust (BBT) triggered by listing review designation (under monitoring) on 2026-03-31.
title_en: Notice regarding costless acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares in connection with termination of equity trust (BBT)
translation_en_brief: UMC Electronics resolved on 2026-08-28 to acquire 128,200 treasury shares costless and cancel them on 2026-09-30. The acquisition and cancellation occur pursuant to termination of the equity trust (BBT—Boshi Baishun Trust, a performance-linked equity compensation vehicle implemented in May 2024 for the period FY2025–FY2029). On 2026-03-31, UMC's shares were designated by the Tokyo Stock Exchange as a listed security under monitoring (審理銘柄（審査中）), which triggered contractual termination of the BBT under its trust agreement provisions. The 128,200 shares represent the residual assets of the terminated trust and will be acquired from Japan Custody Bank (trustee account E) on 2026-08-28 under Companies Act §155(13) and Rules §27(1), then cancelled under §178. The shares represent 0.45% of issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
